description: This file defines the NoteRecyclerAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying Note objects with diffing and payload optimization.

classes.name: NoteRecyclerAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying notes with diffing and payload updates, supporting search mode and hidden notes toggle.

classes.name: DiffCallback
classes.description: A diff callback for comparing Note objects to optimize RecyclerView updates.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Enum representing different types of payload changes for notes.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new NoteViewHolder with inflated layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder, with payload handling for partial updates.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the note at the given position.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data list, filtering hidden notes based on showHiddenNotes flag.
